variables.description: TCP port for the Boardroom web UI (FastAPI). Change if 28473 conflicts with another service on your machine.
Comma-separated tickers used when UNIVERSE_SOURCE=config or as fallback. Set this to fix the training and trading universe without autodiscovery.
How tickers are chosen: config (TRADE_TICKERS), file (UNIVERSE_FILE), or sp500 (live list; risks survivorship bias). Change when you want a custom file-based universe.
Path to a newline-delimited ticker list when UNIVERSE_SOURCE=file. Update when you maintain a fixed universe outside .env.
Number of symbols autodiscovery selects for paper/live runs. Must match PPO n_assets; increase only when retraining with more assets.
Days between automatic universe rescans in paper/live mode. Lower for more frequent refresh; higher to keep a stable basket.
Base URL of your Ollama server for sentiment and boardroom summaries. Change when Ollama runs on another host or port.
Primary Ollama model for narrative sentiment. Switch to a faster or more accurate model you have pulled locally.
Comma-separated backup models tried if the primary fails. Add models from ollama list for resilience.
How long a per-ticker sentiment result is cached before re-querying Ollama. Increase to reduce LLM calls during fast cycling.
Benchmark ticker for the relative-strength specialist score (default SPY). Change to compare against a different index or sector ETF.
OHLCV cache is reused if younger than this many hours. Increase to reduce yfinance fetches during heavy backtests.
Force a full OHLCV refetch when cache exceeds this age in days. Lower for fresher data; set 0 to rely on hours-only checks.

Feature mode for PPO training and inference. proxy = OHLCV-only expanding z-score pipeline (fast, default). specialist = walk-forward real agent outputs (requires pre-generated cache via specialist_features CLI).
Hardware for PPO training: cuda or cpu. Use cpu if GPU is slower or unavailable; cuda when you have a capable GPU.
PyTorch CPU threads when PPO_DEVICE=cpu; 0 uses all cores. Lower to leave headroom for parallel Optuna trials.
Parallel rollout environments (SubprocVecEnv width). Increase for faster sampling if CPU/RAM allow; decrease if subprocesses stall.
Use single-process batched vec env on GPU/CPU for historical-only tuning. Enable (1) for CUDA tuning; leave empty for Subproc default.
Optuna worker processes running concurrent trials on one study. Raise on multi-core machines; keep 1 if SQLite locking causes issues.
Rollout steps collected per env before each PPO update. Larger values stabilize gradients but slow wall-clock time per iteration.
Minibatch size for PPO gradient updates. Increase if GPU memory allows; decrease if training runs out of memory.
Total environment steps for a training run. Raise for longer learning (e.g. 1M+); lower for quick smoke tests.
PPO discount factor. Default 0.99 (effective horizon ~100 days, matches 126-day episodes). Changed from 0.95 in the June 2026 overhaul.
Global random seed for training reproducibility. Tuning uses base_seed + trial_number per trial.
Fraction of episodes on real historical data vs synthetic (0–1). Keep at 1.0 for market-realistic training; lower only for ablation.
Stop training after this many evals with no reward improvement. Set 0 to disable early stopping.
Evaluate holdout reward every N timesteps for early stopping. Set 0 to disable; lower for tighter monitoring.
Minimum eval reward gain that counts as improvement. Raise to require stronger gains before resetting patience.
Adam L2 weight decay for PPO policy/value nets (0 = off). Try small values like 1e-5 if validation reward overfits.
Trading days between expanding-window specialist model refits when building the Mode B walk-forward feature cache. ~63 = quarterly.
Alpaca API key for live and paper broker access. Required for live trading; leave empty if you only backtest locally.
Alpaca secret key paired with ALPACA_API_KEY. Keep secret; rotate if exposed.
Alpaca REST base URL (paper or live). Switch to live-api.alpaca.markets when trading real money.
Path to a .zip PPO checkpoint for live trading; empty uses ppo_trader.zip. Set after training a new model you want deployed.
Discord webhook for trade and cycle notifications. Add your server webhook URL to enable alerts; leave empty to disable.
Generate a one-sentence LLM summary each paper/live cycle. Enable (1/true/yes) for narrative dashboards; off by default to save LLM calls.
Also post the boardroom summary to Discord when enabled. Turn on when you want summaries in your Discord channel.
Minutes between paper/live trading cycles (signals, orders, cached sentiment). Lower for more responsive trading; higher to reduce API load.
Minutes between fresh Ollama sentiment and summary calls in paper/live. Increase to cut LLM usage; sentiment is cached between refreshes.
Trading days between proxy-sentiment recomputes in backtest/training (simulates live Ollama cadence). Unset mirrors OLLAMA_INTERVAL_MIN // CYCLE_INTERVAL_MIN.
Alpaca field that caps buy sizing: non_marginable (cash only) or buying_power (intraday margin). Use cash-only for conservative live runs.
Allow fractional share orders on Alpaca live. Disable (no/false) if your account only supports whole shares.
Initial portfolio value for backtest, paper simulation, and training env accounting. Match your real account size for realistic sizing.
Minimum dollar gap before a rebalance trade fires. Raise to reduce churn and commission impact; lower for finer rebalancing.
Portfolio fraction threshold above MIN_TRADE_NOTIONAL before rebalance. Widen to trade less often; tighten for closer target weights.
Live cooldown: block sells this many minutes after a buy. Increase to reduce flip-flopping; decrease for faster exits.
Live cooldown: block buys this many minutes after a sell. Increase to avoid immediate re-entry; decrease for quicker rebalancing.
Estimated commission drag in basis points for backtest and training reward. Raise to stress-test strategies against higher costs.
Estimated slippage in basis points added to transaction cost in simulation. Increase for conservative execution assumptions.
Simulate Alpaca intraday margin buying-power rules in backtest/training/live. Enable when modeling IMF limits; off for simpler full-exposure sims.
Minimum equity for intraday margin multiplier under IMF simulation. Adjust to match your expected account size.
Intraday buying-power multiplier under IMF (1, 2, or 4). Lower for conservative margin; 4 matches typical Alpaca IMF.
Where to hold out TEST_WINDOW_DAYS: recent (newest data), oldest (earliest), or none (train on all). Change to test how holdout placement affects generalization.
Length of the held-out evaluation window in trading days (~252 = one year). Lengthen for stricter out-of-sample tests.
Years of price history loaded for training and evaluation splits. Increase for more data; decrease if downloads are slow.
Trading days per RL episode in the training env. Shorter episodes train faster; longer (~126) align with multi-month horizons.
Strength of drawdown penalty in the reward (0.3–1.0). Raise for more defensive policies; lower to prioritize raw returns.
When true, total action weights cap at 100% with remainder in cash. Disable to force fully invested portfolios in training.
